What we do

The tough, dirty jobs, done safely

From sewer pump stations to tank cleans and dangerous goods transport, every job is matched to the right unit from our fleet.

Wet Vacuum

Muddy water, concrete slurry, drilling mud, sand, mud, general sludge and sewerage sludge.

Deep Vacuum Loading

Shafts, sewer manholes, pump stations, wet wells, sediment effluent ponds, vacuum excavation and containment traps.

Dangerous Goods

Bulk and packaged dangerous goods waste transport, with a DG-rated tanker, chemical hoses and pumps.

Confined Space & Working at Heights

Sewer pump stations, sewer manholes and storm water drains, plus BA and rescue.

Also: high pressure cleaning, industrial cleaning, chemical extraction and transport, and drain cleaning.
